body:
Step 4 of docs/ios-port-design.md. Background sync and notifications on iOS. Background app refresh
runs when the system chooses, so invite and collaborator notifications by polling are best effort
only. Reliable notifications need Apple push: the server stores device tokens per session and sends
pushes on invite and on collaborator changes. That is a wire change (docs/wire-contract.md, maybe a
protocol bump) and a server dependency on APNs credentials per instance. Design first; blocked until
the iOS shell runs.
title: iPhone port step 4: background sync and push notifications on iOS (design)
